newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Repsol rebounds ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Repsol rebounds ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in Spanish energy group Repsol were higher in mid-morning trade on Tuesday, rebounding after having already discounted what are expected to be disappointing nine-month results later today, dealers said.
At 1025 GMT, Repsol was up 50 pesetas, 1.18 percent, to 4,285 while the Ibex-35 was up 0.59 percent to 4,447.28.

"We're expecting a 12 percent fall in third quarter (attributable) profit, and we think this is already in the price. If the figure is confirmed we think today's (share price) gains will be maintained," said a trader at BBV Interactivos.

BBV forecast a fall in 9-month net attributable profit to 87.7 billion pesetas from 92.15 billion in the year-earlier period, in line with the market consensus for an average 3.6 percent decline in earnings.
A second trader who requested anonymity said he thought the figures might be worse than the 3.5 decrease in net profit and 14.2 percent drop in operating profit he was forecasting.
"It may come off a little if those figures are confirmed, but I think the surprises (from the results breakdown) could be on the downside," he said.
